description: Catalogue of legal forms, templates, official publications, procedural guides, and other legal resources for the PNG Legal Assistance project.
usage_notes: Record source details and verification status before making resources available to users.
Distinguish official prescribed forms from general templates and AI-generated drafts.
Do not assume that a resource is current merely because its webpage or file is accessible.
Check copyright and redistribution permission before storing or distributing document copies.
Where copying permission is unknown, record metadata and the official source link instead.
Never include completed legal documents containing personal or confidential information.
